messages:
olivia: Heads-up — ACME reported a regression after the last canary. Outputs are sometimes getting an old banner/prefix inserted from a previous session (e.g. 'ACME Legal Notice' appears in unrelated responses). Suspect KV/prefix caching crossing model variants.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout completed 2026-03-15T20:12Z: model=redwood-v2-opt-quant, rollout=canary-17, status=success (no service errors).

raj: Do we have a trace/request id from the customer to correlate logs?

olivia: Sent them in DM. Sample trace id: trace-0a1b2c. Sample request/response they pasted: 
```
POST /v1/generate
Body: {"prompt":"Create onboarding text for product X"}
Response: "... Welcome back, ACME Legal Notice..." <-- stale header not related to prompt
```

jake: Looks like the prefix key isn't namespaced by model_variant/model_hash. If a request is routed to compat-quant fallback, the KV prefix key can be identical across variants -> stale prefix reused. I'll grep the runtime path that composes the prefix key.

maria: Workaround we applied for ACME: invalidated their prefix cache from the admin console and their outputs normalized immediately. Command we ran (admin CLI):
```
rictl cache invalidate --scope org:acme --type prefix --pattern "sess:*"
```
They confirmed fix.

jake: Proposed hotfix: include model_hash (short hex) into prefix cache key, e.g. `{org}:{session}:{model_hash}:{prefix_id}`. Short-term patch: force cache invalidation when routing switches model_variant for a session. I will open PR for both.

raj: Can repro locally with a small script: start runtime with KV cache enabled, send prompt A pinned to v2, then trigger routing to compat-quant and send prompt B — observe prefix A leaking into response B. Repro steps I used: 
```bash
# start local runtime with kv=true
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"A"}' -H 'X-Session: sess-42'
# swap variant to compat-quant (simulate routing)
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"B"}' -H 'X-Session: sess-42'
# inspect response: contains A's prefix
```
I've attached logs to the ticket.

olivia: Customer asked for timeline and a postmortem + potential SLA credit. I told them we have a mitigation (cache invalidation) and an engineering fix in progress.

jake: PR #1428 opened (runtime): changes in prefix key generation + adds automatic invalidation on model_variant change. Also adding metric `kv.prefix.misroute` and an alert when misroute > 0.

maria: Adding this to the support playbook: 1) run admin invalidate, 2) collect trace id, 3) escalate to eng runtime if >1 recurrence, 4) notify acct team for possible credit.

olivia: Thanks — keeping thread open until PR merged and PM/CS have the postmortem. :thumbsup:
